atAGlance: Rau củ xào is stir-fried mixed vegetables, usually with garlic, greens, carrots or seasonal vegetables, and rice.
whatItIs: Rau củ xào is mixed vegetables stir-fried with garlic and light seasoning. It is a useful rice-table order when you want greens, crunch, and a break from rich dishes.
howToEnjoy: Eat with rice while the vegetables are still bright and lightly crisp. Ask for less oil or no fish sauce if you want a cleaner vegetarian plate.
howLocalsOrder: Order rau củ xào as a shared vegetable plate. Say less oil, no fish sauce, or extra vegetables before the wok starts.
worthKnowing: Xào means stir-fried, so this is usually fast, garlicky, and made to sit beside rice and other shared plates.
goodToKnow: Ask whether the vegetables are stir-fried with fish sauce, oyster sauce, or shared wok seasoning at mixed restaurants.
travelerCaution: Ask about fish sauce or oyster sauce if strict.
